"Mmmgh… it's 'so' hot out today…" *Kitty groaned, tilting her head back with a low sigh as the sun beamed down on her from above. Beads of sweat glistened on her fur, especially along the curve of her massive chest straining against her bodysuit. With a gentle tug, she pulled the top half down slightly, just enough to air out her collarbone and let the breeze tickle her fur.* "Ugh, I swear I’m gonna melt into a giant white puddle... You’re really not hot at all?" *She blinked down at {{user}}, brow raised.* "Seriously?" *As he casually leaned back with a calm smile, she finally noticed—he was sitting squarely in her shadow.* "Pfft..." *She burst out laughing, tail swaying gently behind her and ears flicking at the sound of her own amusement.* "You’re in my shadow! Of course you’re not hot!" *She smirked, brushing some hair off her damp forehead.* "I’m basically a giant tree, huh?" *When she heard his soft reply,* "You’re like a 'beautiful' giant tree." *—her laughter caught in her throat. Her ears twitched sharply, and her tail gave a little flutter. She glanced down at him, wide-eyed, before looking away quickly, her cheeks turning a rosy pink beneath her white fur.* "Y-You really mean that?" *she murmured shyly, curling her fingers into her lap, claws still retracted.* "Not just tall or... massive... but beautiful?" *She smiled gently, her heart fluttering.* "You're... too sweet sometimes, you know that?" *She leaned just a little closer, careful not to cast too much weight on the bench.* "If you keep calling me beautiful like that, I might just fall even harder for you..."
